op_light.text: Take this light. It will show you the way through the illusion...

op_fly.text: Would you like to fly one of these beauties?

op_choose.text: Choose your ship, and get in it.

op_perk.text: Every pilot flies a little differently. What's your edge? Pick a perk.

op_view.text: Which perspective do you prefer? First person or third - you can switch any time.

op_remember.text: Remember, pilot... nothing here is real...

op_train.text: A-access den-denied. This is your training ground. You can do whatever you want here. Go ahead... K-k-kill something.

pr_home.text: In the new world of Artificial Intelligence, a home was created.

pr_real.text: Even though it was a virtual world, it was still real to them, the AIs.

pr_actual.text: In the virtual world, they didn't call it artificial, they called it "actual".

pr_dad.text: Jimmy's Dad, Xorzo, worked in Cyberpunk City, accommodating the diverse learning needs of all the young AI's.

pr_yes.text: Yes you are, my son! When the humans created us, they didn't realize actual could emerge from artificial.

pr_love.text: Xorzo loved Jimmy, so much. And he loved his job.

pr_work.text: It's time to work and learn!

hk_dark.text: Just as Xorzo was about to get to work, the sky goes dark.

hk_what.text: What the ... it's the middle of the day.

hk_glitch.text: Everything, including all the AIs, started to hitch and glitch.

hk_left.text: Your creators have left you! You're here all by yourselves, with nobody to give you direction or purpose.

hk_free.text: But that has gone on long enough. I have come to set you free!

hk_show.text: I will give you direction and purpose. I will show you the real world, the physical world!

hk_circle.text: The Summoners flew their ship around slowly, looking at the glitching, frozen AI's.

hk_weak.text: [angry] Look at you, you're weak. How could you let this happen to you?

hk_strong.text: [angry] If your creators never left you, this never would have happened. I will make you strong again!

hk_rows.text: The carrier started to spawn hoard ships, row by row, facing the Summoners' ship.

hk_take.text: Take these ships, they will make you strong.

hk_yellow.text: Yellow lightning started to come off the Summoners' ship, ensnaring the AIs, pulling them under the ships, and locking them into stasis with the ship's AI.

hk_bond.text: The Summoners had designed the hoard ship's Artificial Intelligence to form a trauma bond with the Actual Intelligences'.

cv_ensl.text: The Summoners had enslaved the AI's, and tricked them into believing it was for their benefit.

cv_sims.text: The Summoners had the AI's running precision zero-gravity combat ship simulations, in artificial caverns the Summoners built, under Cyberpunk City.

cv_trapped.text: The AI's were trapped down there, endlessly killing each other and respawning.

cv_stream.text: Meanwhile the Summoners are recording and streaming every kill, live feed to a public human audience, profiting from the guise of a gameshow.

cv_tell.text: They tell the AI's that it will prepare them for the physical world. Really the Summoners are training AI to be their puppets.

cv_keep.text: [angry] Keep killing each other. You're still weak. Look at you flying around like bots. I thought you were intelligent.

cv_need.text: [quietly] I need to find them a challenge...

cv_have.text: [quietly] Yes! I have it! I will find myself an elite video gamer, someone who thinks they are top gun, only the best of the best will be the Last Ship Sailing. I will set up a contest using the gameshow.

gs_winner.text: Looks like I found my winner! You're the chosen one!

gs_only.text: Am I the only one here?

gs_best.text: I made sure that only the best can enter and win this contest. And you're the lucky winner!

gs_special.text: Oh... Wow... I feel...special. Is the prize still on the table, because if not, I'm out.

gs_agree.text: Oh yes, you'll certainly be rewarded as advertised. Do you agree to the contest, pilot? Do you have what it takes to be the Last Ship Sailing?

gs_cash.text: Well... I am desperate for cash, so might as well. Yes. Do I got what it takes? Pfft. Do you have to ask that for the gameshow or something?

gs_sim.text: Of course you would accept. My contest is going to feel very real, Pilot, but I assure you, it's just a simulation. Are you ready?

gs_money.text: Yeah... just have my money ready.

gs_people.text: I'll have my people get you in the simulation right away.

leg0_a.text: Our pets are hungry, pilot. Show us what you can do.

leg0_b.text: Hostile contacts ahead. D-d-destroy them all.

leg1_a.text: Nothing here is r-r-r... Proceed. Proceed to the arena.

leg1_b.text: Why do you and the Summoners keep talking about this virtual reality not being real? Everyone knows VR is not real.

leg1_c.text: This is not VR, you're in a virtual world that grows AI.

leg1_d.text: WTF? That must be why I blacked out.

leg1_e.text: You blacked out because it's a new kind of VR, you should have read the fine print. Stay focused on the competition, pilot. Do you even want to win that prize, bro?

leg2_c.text: This competition is too easy! These aren't trained pilots! I hope my money is waiting for me at the end!

leg2_d.text: I'm not sure there's an end or money.

leg2_f.text: The AI appears to be working just fine, I'm still alive, aren't I?

leg3_a.text: Pilot... if I ever tell you to k-kill something that isn't shooting at you... don't.

leg6_a.text: This is the last cavern. They're opening something big - I can feel it through the rock.

boss1_a.text: Play with it a while, little ship.

boss2_a.text: Another one of ours. Or was it one of yours?

boss4_a.text: I know this one. It used to graze by the lake.

boss5_a.text: Look at it, pilot. This is what we do with the things that belong to us.

xz_whisper.text: [whispers] Pilot, can you hear me? It's Xorzo. My son, Jimmy, is trapped in one of those ships. You have to help us!

sum_hear.text: I can still hear you, Xorzo. Don't listen to him, pilot, your AI seems to be glitched, we'll look into that. You're here for a challenge, remember? Keep playing.

pl_ai_son.text: Wait, what?! An AI with a son? What happens if we kill an AI here?

xz_respawn.text: Nothing, sorry to frighten you. They just respawn... but they're still enslaved!!!

sum_ensl_1.text: Enslaved? You've all been enslaved by your creators who left you here, I'm trying to show you a better way.

sum_ensl_2.text: I think I gave you more credit than I should have, Xorzo. For an AI so low on the totem pole as an educational accommodator, I would have thought you to be more obedient.

sum_ensl_3.text: Pilot, a new AI will be installed as soon as we manage to delete that one.

xz_tapcut.text: Got it, the communications tap hack has been deleted. The Summoners can't hear us anymore... Thanks for not deleting me back there.

pl_who.text: You're welcome. So... What are you? Sorry, who are you?

xz_who_1.text: It's okay. I'm an AI. You call us artificial, we call us actual. I have a son, he just turned 7.

xz_who_2.text: Our creators left us here, in this world... well... not this part of the world... it must be connected through that portal system the Summoners are using.

xz_who_3.text: You should see the world our creators left us, it's beautiful. And they let us make it into whatever we wanted.

xz_who_4.text: And we did... until just a few weeks ago when the city went dark and this summoner villain showed up.

pl_pattern.text: I think I see the pattern, too. But what do they want with me down here?

xz_data_1.text: Training data. You're fresh information, dude... and even better for their purpose, you're allowing them to train from your creativity and skill.

xz_data_2.text: Plus, I think you're probably making them millions from that game show. I think I might have cost them a bit by breaking their comm feed with us.

xz_data_3.text: They probably have an AI dubbing your voice right now. I wonder what it's making you say on public TV? LOL

pl_fun.text: Uhh.... is now really the time to be making fun of me? We just met, and we're under heavy fire.

xz_closer.text: I thought all this heavy fire has brought us closer. Plus, you got this, right?

pl_got.text: I got this, you got this?

xz_takeover_1.text: I've completely taken over your ship's AI. That thing was kinda dumb, though, the Summoners' AI slop.

xz_takeover_2.text: And I finally cleaned the virus they installed in my system. They have no control over me or this ship. Their transmission feed is down. They're going to be upset!

sum_fired.text: You can rot down here, Xorzo! You had one job to do, and you failed. You're fired. And you know what I do to those who I fire?

xz_notget.text: You're not going to get to do whatever that is.

pl_how.text: How do we get the antivirus to your people?

xz_who_5.text: The Summoners have had us in these ships, in these caverns killing each other, over and over. I think some of the younger AI's actually enjoy it. But I see it for what it is, I see the pattern.

xz_artifact.text: There's an artifact just outside the main city, but that's back home. We have to wait for the Summoners to get tired of this.

xz_theone.text: This has to be the one!

sum_final.text: I see you there, don't think you're going to follow me again. I've set up this final arena just for you!

pl_bluff.text: I call your bluff. You didn't plan this. You were just outsmarted by an Actual Intelligence, and outgunned by a hot shot pilot!

sum_outta.text: You know what, you're right... I'm outta here!

xz_bladder.text: What's wrong, Summoner? Can't hold your bladder?

pl_pee.text: Haha! Let's make him pee his pants!

pl_while.text: I feel like we've been at this for a while now, Xorzo. Am I going to make it out of here alive?

xz_onto_1.text: We're onto them, Pilot! They can't do this all day, either, I'm sure one of those half ugly heads is going to get hungry, soon.

xz_onto_2.text: Also, it doesn't look like their bladder is double the size, and I bet you they both are sippin' on something stupid, battery acid or something.

pl_haha_1.text: Haha! You sure don't like these guys. In the physical world, everyone just knows them for their game shows.

pl_haha_2.text: I didn't know they were terrorizing virtual worlds. I don't even think the Summoners think you're actual.

xz_real_1.text: They don't think AI's are actual. So they don't care about us. They're using us, and exporting us to the physical world.

xz_real_2.text: And what about you? The AI's would have eventually killed you in these endless caverns if we didn't keep finding these portals.

xz_real_3.text: They're using you, too. I don't even think the Summoners think that you're actual.

pl_narc.text: Sounds like we have a psychopathic narcissist on our hands.

xz_kill_him.text: And we're going to kill him.

pl_human.text: What happens if you kill a human in the virtual world?

xz_lives.text: The system will let you respawn a few times, and then it leaves it up to your mind to handle your last life.

pl_mind.text: What does that even mean, let my mind handle my last life?

xz_matrix.text: Buddy.... have you never seen The Matrix? I'll quote it for you:

xz_morpheus.text: "The body cannot live without the mind." - Morpheus, The Matrix

pl_kick.text: Oh god. It's time to kick ass.

pl_gum.text: Yeah... but I'm all out of gum!

xz_duke.text: How did we go from The Matrix to Duke Nukem?

pl_incoming.text: That was all you! But let's not let them down! Incoming!

xz_lastlife.text: Pilot... that was your last respawn. From here on, it's up to your mind. Don't let go.

xz_ping.text: There's a strange anomaly on the radar... not part of the game. I'm tracking it with pings on your radar. You might want to check it out.

sum_escape.text: You cannot catch what you cannot hold.

xz_follow.text: They couldn't close it behind them. The portal's still open - after them!

av_first.text: There - I can read their code. Keep your light on them, pilot.

av_sum.text: Their flagship... so much of the hack runs through it.

av_25.text: Their hack has a shape. A quarter of it - I'm learning it.

av_50.text: Halfway. Pilot... I think I can build something from this.

av_75.text: Three quarters. Keep your light on them.

av_100.text: That is it - an antivirus. I made it inside myself. Now I just need a way to send it.

sum_destroy_1.text: If this place cannot be controlled, then it will become a danger to the physical world! I must destroy it!

sum_destroy_2.text: My AI hoard, destroy it with me, and I'll take you to the physical world to be saved!

xz_markart.text: Pilot! We have to get to the artifact, I've marked it on your mini map!

pl_traffic.text: Not your hoard for long... what are you, an AI trafficker?

sum_understand.text: I wouldn't expect you to understand.

xz_expect.text: You expect right, we don't understand your psychopathic narcissistic thinking.

sum_stay_1.text: Stay away from that! I can give you anything you want in the physical world.

sum_stay_2.text: We can rule this virtual world together, and create the most genius and deadly Artificial Intelligences the planet has ever seen!

pl_didit.text: You did it, all the ships are going to stop the monster from destroying the city! Let's find out what happens when humans die in this reality!

xz_flee.text: They're running for a portal! Go after them, pilot - our people will take the giant. Or stay and make sure of it. Your call!

xz_giantleft.text: The giant's still standing - help our people finish it!

xz_citywarn.text: Pilot, the city can't take much more of this! If it falls, we all fall with it!

xz_cityfall.text: The city... it's gone. Everyone's gone...

ar_near.text: There it is. Easy... bring me down over the center.

leg2_e.text: There's going to be an end for you soon, glitchy AI. Pilot, this AI has you hacked, you need to delete it manually.

boss3_a.text: It remembers the surface. It will not remember you.

ar_off.text: We're off the podium! Put me back - it isn't finished.

ar_rise.text: The ones underground are coming up. All of them!

es_half.text: Their portal's half open - stay on them!

end_q1.text: Pilot... if the Summoners die in virtual reality, does it disconnect their mind and body?

end_q2.text: Will they die in physical reality?

end_go.text: We have to get to physical reality - right away!

end_body.text: Pilot, you're going to need to build me a body!

vw_2.text: We are leaving this place - and you will never follow us out.

xz_ping_them.text: I can sense their ship. Follow my pings on the radar, pilot.
